title: Seoul is beginning to look like Christmas
caption:
Department stores in Seoul are launching elaborate holiday displays nearly two months early. From Victorian markets to massive light installations, retailers are racing to transform the city into a festive destination.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul is beginning to look like Christmas
